mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pay_Clause as conPayClause, fp.Fp_Date as fpDate, fp.Create_Uname as createUname, c1.C_Name as fpdPayeeName, mn.* from Fund_Plan_Dtl mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Fund_Plan fp on fp.id = mn.Fp_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Name=mn.Fpd_Payee_Id where fp.id = #{fpId} order by fp.Create_Time desc, mn.Fpd_Sort asc
